Hercules Benchmarking

An evaluation harness and live trajectory visualizer for 300 Salesforce benchmark tasks.

AutoGenSCUBAGradioGKE

What I built

  • Integrated TestZeus-Hercules into the SCUBA benchmark: 300 Salesforce tasks across admin, sales, and service personas.
  • Adapted the evaluation pipeline for an AutoGen-based architecture, handling authentication, org reset, milestone grading, and trajectory capture.
  • Automated conversion of SCUBA task descriptions into Gherkin feature files for structured execution.
  • Analyzed benchmark failures using GKE run artifacts and built a Gradio live visualizer for agent trajectories.

Focus

Evaluating agents beyond the demo

Cloud infrastructure & operations

  • Deployed and maintained the evaluation harness on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
  • Automated infrastructure provisioning and environment resets, including secure authentication and distributed state management.
  • Investigated container performance bottlenecks, network latency, and infrastructure failures using GKE logs and monitoring metrics.
  • Developed real-time monitoring views for container health, execution paths, and deployment metrics.
